description: This Kotlin test source file contains performance tests for the NoteViewHolder in an Android application, focusing on how the UI updates in response to payloads and the interaction with the Markwon library for markdown rendering.

classes.name: NoteListPerformanceTest
classes.description: A test class for measuring and verifying the performance and correct behavior of note list UI components, particularly focusing on ViewHolder updates and payload handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by setting up application context and theme.

methods.name: testNoteViewHolderTitleUpdateViaPayload
methods.description: Tests updating the note title in the ViewHolder via payloads and verifies UI updates.

methods.name: testNoteViewHolderContentUpdateViaPayload_NonMarkdown
methods.description: Tests updating note content without markdown enabled and verifies UI updates.

methods.name: testNoteViewHolderContentUpdateViaPayload_Markdown
methods.description: Tests updating note content with markdown enabled and verifies Markwon parsing and rendering.

methods.name: testAdapterPayloadFlattening
methods.description: Tests flattening of multiple payloads during adapter binding and ensures ViewHolder processes combined payloads correctly.
